title: Brand architecture
slide_intent: Teach communicators to identify who is speaking so a reader can distinguish an organizational program, a local event and an endorsed partner.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can allow local identities while keeping the relationship to the international movement visible.
demonstration: The upper band pairs the international and program marks with local club examples. Three panels below contrast health and education programs, events and games, and endorsed activities.
practical_value: Choose the naming and endorsement relationship before commissioning artwork for a new activity.

content_islands.name: Strategy column
content_islands.spec: Place the principle and explanation at left. Identify the movement as the primary brand.

content_islands.name: Organization and teams
content_islands.spec: Set the international and accredited marks together above the activity panels. Place the club and team marks beside them.

content_islands.name: Relationship panels
content_islands.spec: Build three parallel cards. Pair an actual identifier with naming, identity and example guidance so readers can compare categories.
